description: Read YouTube Shorts from channel Shorts tabs, from a YouTube search with the Shorts filter, or from Short links. Returns one row per Short with exact views, likes, comment count, publish date, hashtags, and channel, plus a free report row per source. Channels can be sorted by latest, popular, or oldest.

channels.description: Channel handles (@MrBeast or MrBeast), channel links (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast), or UC channel IDs. Each channel's Shorts tab is read.

details.description: yes (default): read each Short for exact views, likes, comment count, and publish date, priced per Short with details. no: return only what the list shows (ID, title, rounded views, thumbnail) at the lower list price. Short links always get details.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Report rows are always returned.

max_shorts_per_source.description: Shorts to return from each channel or search. YouTube shows about 48 a page. Default 30, maximum 1000.

search_terms.description: Words to search on YouTube with the Shorts filter, one term per line, for example iced coffee recipe. YouTube orders the results.

shorts.description: Single Shorts: links such as https://www.youtube.com/shorts/sHpEqeSByPI, watch links, youtu.be links, or 11 character video IDs. Each one gets a row with its details.

sort.description: Order of a channel's Shorts tab: latest (default), popular (most viewed), or oldest. Searches keep YouTube's own order.

name: get_youtube_shorts
title: Get YouTube Shorts
